'''2003 Florida State Championship Neal Razi LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Neal Razi]] at [[2003 Florida State Championship]], finishing 1st; the list below is as posted on DeckTech by Neal "Dredlox" Razi (2003-09-02).<ref name="src">[http://www.decktech.net/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=30202 Recycling Republicans Fl States winner]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20050525170053/http://www.decktech.net:80/starwarsccg/decks/decks.php?deck=30202&PHPSESSID=...328fedb22570524062aeb1303 Internet Archive]</ref>
